acceptance.criterion: Backend URL is hardcoded to https://hydragrow.onrender.com: getDefaultBackendUrl() returns the Render URL unconditionally in all runtimes, and the platform settings test asserts the hardcoded value

Pairing flow is reachable via client-side routing only: Settings uses React Router navigate('/pairing') (no window.location.href), OnboardingWizard step 4 navigates to the existing /cultivation route, and App.tsx redirects legacy /seasons to /cultivation
Dashboard and ControlPanel render with no sensor data: no early return on !sensorData, optional-chained sensor access, and an info banner in ControlPanel for the no-data state
Page structure is consistent: FleetView, UserManagement, and ConfigBackup use the shared app-page wrapper and page-header pattern like the rest of the app
Design-token compliance: bg-soft utility is defined, hardcoded hex overlays/status backgrounds are replaced with theme tokens, and DevicePairing uses bg-faint instead of banned bg-slate-300

Component and layout consistency: Switch/InputGroup duplicate props are deprecated with single canonical APIs, AuthCard uses standard ui-form-row spacing and p-4 md:p-5 padding, QuickActionBar uses standard rounded-xl
Full frontend verification passes: tsc --noEmit exit 0, vitest 108 files / 541 tests pass, eslint 0 errors, npm run build exit 0

objective: Fix device pairing reachability, hardcode the backend URL, render Dashboard/ControlPanel without sensor data, expose the onboarding setup flow, and standardize page structure, design tokens, and component APIs across the frontend.
